# Choosing a workspace structure

Most people overthink this. Start with **one workspace per client** and a **Personal** workspace for everything else.

## Why per client?

- Tokens and AI only see one workspace, so a client's notes never leak into another's prompt.
- Deleting a finished client is one action.

## Inside a workspace

1. One **project** per deliverable (website, brand, campaign)
2. Folders only when a project passes ~20 pages
3. Pin the 3 pages you open daily

## Example

```text
Fevgo/
  Website/
    Homepage brief
    Sitemap
  Brand/
    Voice and tone
```

---

*Rule of thumb:* if you can't name the folder in two words, you don't need it yet.
